content_descriptors.notes: Over the course of the story, player will encounter: usage of guns, violence, and consumption of tobacco. Echoes introduces body-horror elements towards the second half of the story.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 and later (64bits only)
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz (with SSE2 instruction set support)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphic card with 512MB of VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 and later (64bits only)
  • Processor: 2.6 Ghz (with SSE2 instruction set support)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphic card with 512MB of VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
